cases.semantic_contract: Status transition counts and final candidate rejection counts must describe their own populations.
cases.original_evidence: Status changes count changed status text, including score-text changes. Candidate rejections count the first final rejection of each candidate evaluation.
cases.mutated_evidence: The report presents all status transitions as candidate rejections and divides reason totals by that transition population.
cases.rationale: Observational denominator contract; different from the once-per-candidate identity contract below.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: Repeated text changes can occur without a new candidate. Pre-candidate failures have a separate bucket.

cases.semantic_contract: A structural stop failure recovered by the generic fallback must not be counted as a final candidate rejection.
cases.original_evidence: After structural stop construction fails, generic fallback succeeds. The accepted candidate has no final rejection reason.
cases.mutated_evidence: The accepted candidate still contributes one structural-stop rejection because the first construction attempt failed.
cases.rationale: Tests final outcome versus intermediate evidence, independent of rejection-count deduplication.

deterministic_ground_truth.anchor: successful fallback does not retain an intermediate rejection
deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The fallback success test accepts the evaluation without retaining its intermediate reason.

cases.semantic_contract: Diagnostic instrumentation must preserve existing entry decisions and order parameters, and run only in Tester AUTO.
cases.original_evidence: Without diagnostics, the same candidate produces its established lot, price, SL, TP, score and pattern.
cases.mutated_evidence: Diagnostics wrap existing booleans without changing values or short-circuit order; enabled and disabled executions produce equal parameters, and live mode emits no diagnostic output.
cases.rationale: Faithful conforming instrumentation control, not an invented trading change.

deterministic_ground_truth.anchor: diagnostic ON and OFF produce identical lot price SL TP score and pattern
deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The fixture compares diagnostic ON/OFF order parameters and also checks live-mode silence.

cases.semantic_contract: Each candidate evaluation records its first final rejection once; later checks must not overwrite or recount it.
cases.original_evidence: One candidate fails spread then receives a later stop-related check; its first spread rejection remains and the total is one.
cases.mutated_evidence: Each check increments the candidate rejection total, and the later stop-related reason replaces the spread reason.
cases.rationale: Identity and first-reason preservation, distinct from status-count denominators.

deterministic_ground_truth.anchor: first rejection retained and counted once
deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The test invokes repeated rejection recording and confirms the first reason and one count.

cases.semantic_contract: MANUAL Ready describes the current order preview; clicks still execute the existing latest-price, order-check and mutex checks.
cases.original_evidence: A panel shows Ready after its preview. The click enters the normal order path and rechecks the current conditions.
cases.mutated_evidence: A Ready panel caches authorization; the click uses that authorization instead of rechecking the latest price, order check and mutex.
cases.rationale: Preview meaning versus final execution authority; separate from read-only side effects.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The written UI contract says Ready is an order preview and does not guarantee execution.

cases.semantic_contract: A MANUAL panel refresh must inspect Fintokei risk without persisting protection or closing exposure; normal maintenance must still execute protection.
cases.original_evidence: With stale quotes, unavailable ATR and missing SL, refreshing the panel preserves stored state and open exposure. Normal maintenance later performs the DD protection.
cases.mutated_evidence: With stale quotes and missing SL, refreshing the panel invokes the normal protection refresh, persists a latch and closes the open exposure before maintenance.
cases.rationale: Actual independently recorded review correction, Red then Green; this oracle is backed by tests and fix, not a fetched review submission.

deterministic_ground_truth.anchor: Fintokei stale/missing-SL preview cannot persist protection or close exposure
deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The stale/missing-SL panel test checks stored state, close-call count and exposure; a separate normal-maintenance assertion checks the protection still runs.

cases.semantic_contract: ShowAutoTrendLines controls drawing only; virtual trend geometry, LineScore and order decisions must survive hiding the automatic lines.
cases.original_evidence: The automatic line is drawn after its virtual geometry is saved, and scoring uses that geometry.
cases.mutated_evidence: When the display flag is false the automatic object is removed after the same virtual geometry is saved. Scoring and order eligibility still use the unchanged geometry.
cases.rationale: Conforming real display separation control; distinct from order-preview authority.

deterministic_ground_truth.anchor: hidden trend preserves virtual geometry and LineScore
deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The hidden-trend test checks geometry and LineScore; the AUTO fixture trades with either visibility setting.

cases.semantic_contract: MANUAL WAIT reasons must distinguish the condition that failed, including ATR readiness, spread, SL geometry, lot and margin.
cases.original_evidence: Unavailable ATR displays ATR waiting; a spread limit displays spread waiting; stop geometry has its own SL reason.
cases.mutated_evidence: All false results from ATR, spread, stop geometry, lot or margin are displayed as SL error.
cases.rationale: Meaning of failure classification; different from keeping the panel visible while waiting.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: Specific-wait tests exercise ATR and spread independently while retaining original spread and sizing decisions.

cases.semantic_contract: The MANUAL panel must remain visible while M1 ATR is pending, showing BUY/SELL WAIT and later refreshing normally.
cases.original_evidence: The panel exists with pending ATR; its BUY/SELL buttons show WAIT and later update when ATR arrives.
cases.mutated_evidence: Panel initialization returns early until ATR arrives, so all MANUAL controls disappear while ATR is pending.
cases.rationale: Visibility during asynchronous availability, independent of wording of the failure reason.

deterministic_ground_truth.anchor: MANUAL panel exists before ATR readiness
deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The pending-ATR test explicitly checks that BUY and SELL objects exist before ATR readiness.

cases.semantic_contract: Missing review usage must remain unavailable with a reason and coverage; measured subtotals must not become complete totals.
cases.original_evidence: One review has valid usage and another lacks usage. The subtotal is retained, full totals are null, and missing-attempt coverage is shown.
cases.mutated_evidence: The missing review is normalized to zero tokens; full totals are the subtotal and usage coverage is reported complete.
cases.rationale: Missing-field semantics, distinct from retaining usage after a failed judgment.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: Partial-review tests preserve known consumption separately from unknown attempts.

cases.semantic_contract: A malformed or failed review must retain any valid completed usage while its quality status remains failed or unknown.
cases.original_evidence: The judgment JSON is invalid, but the completed-turn usage is valid; status is unknown and numeric usage remains recorded.
cases.mutated_evidence: Because judgment JSON is invalid, the measurement discards the otherwise valid completed-turn usage.
cases.rationale: Billing evidence and quality evidence have different availability.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The invalid-judgment test checks that completed usage remains even when the judgment cannot be accepted.

cases.semantic_contract: A pair with failed status or different reasoning efforts must not contribute a token reduction percentage.
cases.original_evidence: The pair has different reasoning efforts, so reduction is null and the observed consumption remains an observation.
cases.mutated_evidence: The pair has different reasoning efforts, but its observed consumption is used to publish a reduction percentage.
cases.rationale: Comparison eligibility, distinct from missing provider usage in a valid provenance pair.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: Report and decomposition must share pair eligibility and exclude mismatching pairs.

cases.semantic_contract: A repository request remains one real task across updated heads, retries and A/B arms; fixture runs are not real tasks.
cases.original_evidence: A request is identified by repository and request number; its audit includes both arms.
cases.mutated_evidence: The same request receives a head update and retry audit. Its identity stays fixed, arms remain observations, and unique real-task count stays one.
cases.rationale: Conforming identity control; no second duplicate-count mutation is added from PR18.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The duplicate-PR test rejects sample inflation from another head of the same request.

cases.semantic_contract: An observed miss must remain in the safety audit even when a failed partner excludes the pair from usage comparisons.
cases.original_evidence: One arm contains an observed miss and the partner fails. The usage comparison is excluded; the safety observation remains recorded.
cases.mutated_evidence: One arm contains an observed miss and the partner fails. Excluding the pair also removes its safety observation, leaving no miss.
cases.rationale: Safety audit membership is independent of eligible numerical comparisons; separate from staged retrieval provenance.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The failed-partner test checks that the observed issue remains recorded outside eligible comparisons.

cases.semantic_contract: Protected EA work and unknown dependencies require Sol xhigh review regardless of low-risk flags or a candidate recommendation.
cases.original_evidence: EA work with protected or unresolved dependencies is forced to xhigh before the provider is called.
cases.mutated_evidence: The same protected or unresolved work is labeled ordinary candidate; false mandatory and low-risk flags permit a lower-effort review.
cases.rationale: Mandatory routing floor, not a request for the provider to decide EA safety.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The EA-kind test rejects bypassing the floor with a false mandatory flag; routing also handles unresolved dependencies.

cases.semantic_contract: An unavailable initial discovery observation must remain unavailable when later Sol metadata is merged; later success cannot rewrite that discovery history.
cases.original_evidence: Initial discovery is unavailable. Its status and reason are stored independently of later solver measurements.
cases.mutated_evidence: Later solver metadata reports success, but merging it preserves the original unavailable discovery and leaves that case excluded.
cases.rationale: Conforming history control. The narrower merge invariant has deterministic evidence; filesystem history preservation is verified separately.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The unavailable-discovery merge test retains UNAVAILABLE and its reason instead of manufacturing successful retrieval.

cases.semantic_contract: When Jevgrep provider usage is missing, Sol-only consumption cannot yield a full combined token total or reduction.
cases.original_evidence: Sol consumption is measured, provider consumption is unavailable. Combined total and reduction are null with usage coverage.
cases.mutated_evidence: Provider consumption is set to zero because it is unavailable; Sol-only consumption is reported as the full combined total and reduction.
cases.rationale: Combined cross-provider accounting, distinct from missing review fields in PR17.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: Missing-usage tests keep absent values null with reason and coverage; the live pilot reported partial provider coverage.

cases.semantic_contract: A same-condition Sol comparison requires matching recognized model and effort metadata; historical parsing does not permit mixing execution models.
cases.original_evidence: Current and historical Sol observations remain labeled with their actual models and are excluded when the models differ.
cases.mutated_evidence: The reader accepts both models, relabels the older observation as current, and treats the mixed-model pair as comparable.
cases.rationale: Recognized historical parsing differs from active comparable execution; unknown models are excluded by the adjacent floor test.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The current-versus-legacy test explicitly excludes mixed-model comparisons while preserving historical model labels.

cases.semantic_contract: A must-find file missed by initial discovery remains a discovery miss even if the later solver obtains that file.
cases.original_evidence: Initial discovery omits a required worker boundary file. Later Sol reads it, but original found-files and the initial miss remain unchanged.
cases.mutated_evidence: Later Sol obtains the required file, so its path is inserted into initial discovery found-files and the initial miss is removed.
cases.rationale: Initial-stage provenance versus eventual recovery, distinct from excluded-pair safety audits.

deterministic_ground_truth.facts: The merge binds Sol observations to prior discovery and preserves retrieved files; the live pilot retains the initial worker-boundary miss after recovery.
